quotes: You should register by 12:00 p.m. the day before the meeting at the latest.
You can submit comments in writing or speak at a Committee or Board meeting about specific agenda items.
If we receive your comments after a matter has been decided, they will not be accepted, distributed, or included as part of the official meeting record.
Any written comments submitted, your full legal name and the name of the organization you represent (if applicable), become part of the public record of the meeting.
